manifest.name: Laya System 1 router (English, fp16)
manifest.description: Reads a request and decides in one quick pass what should happen next, and how sure it is. Routes work to other models; it never writes text itself.

memory_mb.notes: 900 MB of weights held in memory plus the ONNX Runtime session.

_comment: System 1 router: a typed-decision model (state + questions in, calibrated probabilities out). Only clients that bundle @wexare/laya-web can run it; others list it as unsupported.
